_meta.source: The Football Database (footballdb.com), team-stats/offense-totals and team-stats/defense-totals, regular season final totals per year.
_meta.note: Ranks 1=best. Convention: preseason games use the PRIOR season's final rankings (season hasn't started); playoff games use that season's own final rankings (regular season just concluded). Matches the convention already used for real 2026 preseason snapshots in data/history.json.
